summary: The United States has authorized Israel to operate freely in Iraqi airspace to strike Iranian-backed militias, while Israel prepares for a potential short, intense war against Palestinian Authority forces in the West Bank. Simultaneously, a wave of Israeli airstrikes in Lebanon is imminent, and border incidents in southern Syria have resulted in detentions and one fatality.
key_points: The U.S. gave Israel a green light to operate freely in Iraqi airspace, enabling the Israeli Air Force to attack Iranian militias in the region. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94499)

Defense Minister Katz stated the IDF is preparing for a scenario where PA security forces and Tanzim turn against settlers and IDF troops in the West Bank and seam zone, which would trigger a short, intense war per the Gaza and Lebanon model. (Source: @amitsegal/65557)

A wave of combat airstrikes in Lebanon is expected in the coming hours, with explosions likely heard in the Upper Galilee, Hula Valley, Ramim Ridge, and possibly the northern Golan. (Source: @pkpoi/144187)

Two unarmed suspects on a motorcycle approached an IDF position in southern Syria; soldiers opened fire, wounding one and detaining both. A separate unarmed suspect trying to breach a nearby post was shot dead. (Source: @manniefabian/59321)

Trump said he personally believes Iran was responsible for the Flydubai plane hijacking attempt; the U.S. moved ~12 B-1 bombers from RAF Fairford in the UK due to an alleged Iranian drone threat. (Source: @mamlekate/104789)
Iran summoned the French ambassador to protest the violent crackdown on student demonstrations, citing over 5,000 arrests and injuries including blindness. (Source: @presstv/209711)
Iraqi Kurdistan Prime Minister Masrour Barzani said the region needs more allied help to acquire counter-drone and air defense systems after coalition withdrawal. (Source: @naya_foriraq/92690)
An Omani co-pilot who attempted to crash a Flydubai flight into a U.S. base in Jordan told interrogators his motive was revenge for events in Gaza. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94503)

points: Iran's Army Chief Major General Amir Hatami warned that the armed forces will give a crushing response if enemies repeat mistakes and pose new threats against Iran. (Source: @presstv/209706)

Trump stated he personally believes Iran was responsible for the Flydubai plane hijacking attempt, while JD Vance said no conclusive evidence of Iranian involvement has been received yet. (Source: @VahidOnline/78629)

The U.S. abruptly relocated approximately 12 B-1 bombers from RAF Fairford in the UK due to immediate concerns about a potential Iranian drone attack allegedly ordered by the IRGC. (Source: @mamlekate/104789)

Iran summoned the French ambassador to Tehran to lodge a strong protest over the violent crackdown on peaceful student demonstrations, citing over 5,000 arrests and injuries including blindness. (Source: @presstv/209711)
Bloomberg reported that U.S. economic pressure has succeeded and Iranian negotiators are now seeking a rapid return to the June understandings. (Source: @mamlekate/104787)
Trump claimed unprecedented volumes of oil are now flowing through the Strait of Hormuz daily, dismissing the strait as a factor in rising gasoline prices. (Source: @VahidOnline/78628)

Defense Minister Katz revealed the IDF is preparing for a scenario where PA security forces and Tanzim flip against settlers and IDF in the West Bank and seam zone, which would trigger a declared war with a short, intense campaign using ground and air forces, special means, targeted killings, deportations, weapons destruction, mass evacuations, and infrastructure demolition in cities and refugee camps per the Gaza and Lebanon model. (Source: @amitsegal/65557)
The U.S. gave Israel a green light to operate freely in Iraqi airspace, allowing the Israeli Air Force to attack Iranian militias in the area. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94499)

A wave of combat airstrikes in Lebanon is expected in the coming hours, with explosions likely heard in the Upper Galilee, Hula Valley, Ramim Ridge, and possibly the northern Golan. (Source: @pkpoi/144187)
Shin Bet agents flew to the UAE to participate in the interrogation of the Flydubai co-pilot who attempted to hijack the Dubai-Tel Aviv flight. (Source: @manniefabian/59322)

IDF Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir, Police Commissioner Danny Levy, and Shin Bet Chief David Zini held a joint multi-arena assessment ahead of the sensitive election period, agreeing on joint steps to strengthen multi-arena defense, counter-terrorism, and combat nationalist crime. (Source: @pkpoi/144191)
U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio spoke with Prime Minister Netanyahu, per a State Department spokesperson. (Source: @New_security8200/204118)

Defense Minister Katz outlined a war plan against the Palestinian Authority involving a short, intense campaign with ground and air forces, special means, targeted killings and deportations of senior officials, destruction of weapons, mass evacuation of residents, and demolition of terror infrastructure in all West Bank cities and refugee camps, modeled on Gaza and Lebanon operations. (Source: @amitsegal/65557)

The Jerusalem Faction threatened to disrupt October 7 memorial events after a Haredi draft dodger from Hebron Yeshiva was arrested by military police while on vacation in Eilat. (Source: @yediotnews25/135858)

Haredi party leaders declared they will not support any government without a draft law, citing renewed arrests of yeshiva student draft evaders as proof the Jerusalem Faction's approach was correct. (Source: @yediotnews25/135849)

A wave of combat airstrikes in Lebanon is expected in the coming hours, with explosions likely heard in the Upper Galilee, Hula Valley, Ramim Ridge, and possibly the northern Golan. (Source: @pkpoi/144187)

Hezbollah Secretary General Sheikh Naim Qassem announced the launch of an institution to preserve and disseminate the legacy of Sayyed Hassan Nasrallah, decided by the Hezbollah Shura Council and overseen by the Secretary General with an integrated structure. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/397485)
A Lebanese Army explosion is anticipated soon in Tyre, Al-Shawakir area, per a warning notice. (Source: @redlinkleb/46774)

Two unarmed suspects on a motorcycle approached an IDF position in the buffer zone in southern Syria; soldiers initiated a suspect arrest procedure with live fire, wounding one and detaining both for questioning in Israel. (Source: @manniefabian/59321)

In a separate incident the previous night, an unarmed suspect tried to breach a different nearby army post in southern Syria; a Carmeli Brigade reservist opened fire and shot the suspect dead when he continued advancing. (Source: @manniefabian/59321)
The U.S. authorized Israel to operate freely in Iraqi airspace to strike Iranian-backed militias. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94499)

Iraqi Kurdistan Prime Minister Masrour Barzani stated the region is not worried about security problems post-coalition withdrawal but urgently needs allied help to acquire counter-drone systems and enhance air defense capabilities. (Source: @naya_foriraq/92690)

An Omani co-pilot who attempted to hijack a Flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv told interrogators he had an alternative plan to crash the plane into a U.S. base in Jordan, motivated by revenge for events in Gaza. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94503)

Shin Bet agents traveled to the UAE to participate in the interrogation of the Flydubai co-pilot, Hamam al-Hammami, who attacked the pilot on a flight carrying mostly Israeli passengers. (Source: @manniefabian/59322)

Trump said he personally believes Iran was responsible for the Flydubai plane incident, while JD Vance stated no conclusive evidence of Iranian involvement has been obtained. (Source: @VahidOnline/78629)

sections.threat_assessment: Israel is simultaneously preparing for high-intensity conflict on three fronts: a potential war against the Palestinian Authority in the West Bank modeled on Gaza operations, continued strikes in Lebanon with imminent airstrikes, and expanded operations in Iraqi airspace against Iranian militias with U.S. backing. The southern Syria border remains active with infiltration attempts. Iran's alleged involvement in the Flydubai hijacking attempt and the U.S. bomber relocation from the UK indicate a widening aviation threat dimension. Iraqi Kurdistan's request for air defense systems highlights growing vulnerability to drone threats across the region.
sections.regional_response: The U.S. has greenlit Israeli operations in Iraqi airspace and relocated strategic bombers from the UK, signaling deep military coordination. Iran has responded diplomatically by summoning the French ambassador over domestic protests while its military leadership issues crushing response warnings. Hezbollah is institutionalizing Nasrallah's legacy organizationally. Iraqi Kurdistan is seeking Western air defense assistance. Jordan's security is implicated by the Omani pilot's plot against a U.S. base on its territory. The UAE is cooperating with Israeli intelligence on the Flydubai investigation.
sections.intelligence_notes: The Flydubai hijacking attempt reveals a novel threat vector: insider aviation attacks motivated by Gaza, with the perpetrator having a secondary plan targeting a U.S. base in Jordan. The U.S. bomber relocation from RAF Fairford suggests credible intelligence on Iranian drone capabilities reaching UK territory. Israel's multi-arena security assessment ahead of elections indicates concern about domestic instability intersecting with external threats. The PA war plan's explicit reference to the Gaza/Lebanon model suggests doctrinal continuity in Israeli urban warfare approach. Kurdistan's air defense request points to a capability gap after coalition drawdown.
